|translation=AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Luke Skywalker, Lieutenant Colonel</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>Hero of the Battle of Yavin. Over these three years, he gained experience as a soldier of the Alliance, and his current rank is lieutenant colonel. At the Battle of Hoth, he served as the leader of Echo Base's flight squadron.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere afterward. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 1, adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition &lt; 3. All other Rogue Squadron pilots and gunners at the same Hoth location have forfeit +1.</blockquote>

The Japanese title and lore use 中佐, a rank term translated as lieutenant colonel or, in naval usage, commander; the English printing uses Commander. The Japanese game text explicitly says "if piloting Rogue 1"; the English face says "On Rogue 1". Both printed faces give the +3 power bonus to a starship he pilots. The Japanese lore describes three years of military experience and his current rank, rather than the English sentence about promotion in his third year. The final Japanese sentence uses 位置 (location), whereas the original English face specifies a "site".<ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Hoth-L-commanderlukeskywalker-decipher-archive.gif|Original English card face]].</ref>
